use_cases: Displaying daily fitness metrics with circular progress indicators like Apple Watch activity rings
Health and wellness dashboard widget showing Move, Exercise, and Stand goals
Visualizing progress toward fitness targets with animated ring indicators
Tracking health metrics in mobile and desktop fitness applications
Presenting health data with colorful, gradient-styled circular progress visualizations
ai_summary: Apple Activity Card is a fitness-inspired data display component that mimics Apple Watch activity rings, showing Move, Exercise, and Stand metrics with animated circular progress indicators. Features gradient-styled rings in vibrant colors (pink, green, cyan) with smooth mount animations, designed for health tracking dashboards and fitness applications across mobile and desktop platforms.
